meta.title: Retro Pixel Themes
meta.description: Adds a “Retro Pixel Themes” entry to the left sidebar and restyles the whole app with twelve visual styles: Aurora, Midnight, Ember, Verdant, a warm low-glare Paper tone, plus seven pixel styles (Terminal, True Amber CRT, Ice CRT, Magenta Synthwave, Retro B&W TV, Pixel Boy, Sunset Dune). Your choice is remembered, and “System default” restores the built-in themes.
